name: Alpha Beetle
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Sharpened Pincers: Charge forward to deal 3 damage and push the target.. The Alpha Beetle charges forward in a line, dealing 3 damage and pushing the first target it hits.

name: Mine-Mech
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Minelayer: Deploy a single Freeze mine.. Special: Mine Immunity: This unit avoids mines. | Smoke Immunity: This unit is unaffected by Smoke..

name: Firefly Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Burning Thorax: Launch goo projectiles in two directions, dealing 4 damage with each.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Firefly Leader attacks by firing two straight-shooting projectiles that damage for four each. It will prioritise targeting two units if possible.

name: Alpha Scarab
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Spitting Glands: Lob a powerful artillery shot at a single tile for 3 damage (5 tile range).. Alpha Scarabs are shaped like soft-shelled beetles. They attack similarly to artillery style Mech weapons. Alpha Scarabs will aim in a straight line at a tile and shoot over any tiles in between them and their target.

name: Spider
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Tiny Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. As a rare Vek, Spiders cannot spawn on the first island, and are limited to one spawn per mission (including its alpha).

name: Alpha Spider
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Large Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Alpha Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. The Spiderling's stats from the Alpha Spider are identical to that of the regular Spiders. As a rare Vek, Alpha Spiders cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to one spawn per mission.

name: Pulse Mech
text: Health 3, move 4. Weapon: Repulse: Push all adjacent tiles. Power: Free. Upgrades: Shield Self (1 Reactor Core): Creates a personal Shield when used; Shield Friendly (2 Reactor Cores): Shield adjacent ally or Building.

name: Laser Mech
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapon: Burst Beam: Fire a piercing beam that decreases in damage the further it goes. Damage: 3-1. Power: Free. Upgrades: Ally Immune (1 Reactor Core): Friendly units will not take damage from this attack. (Buildings will still be damaged and shields will be removed); +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases the starting damage by 1.

name: Hook Mech
text: Keywords: Natural Armor. Health 3, move 3. Weapon: Grappling Hook: Use a grapple to pull Mech towards immovable objects, or units to the Mech. Power: Free. Upgrades: Shield Ally (1 Reactor Core): If used on an ally unit it gives them a Shield.

name: Boulder Mech
text: Health 2, move 3. Weapon: Rock Accelerator: Launch a rock at a tile, pushing tiles to the left and right. Damage: 2. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 1.

name: Slide Mech
text: Health 2, move 4. Weapon: Area Shift: Push self and all adjacent tiles. Power: Free. Upgrades: Shield Self (1 Reactor Core): Shield the user when activated; Shield Ally (2 Reactor Cores): Shield any Ally units affected by this skill.

name: Smog Mech
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapon: Smoldering Shells: Damage and apply Fire to a tile while adding Smoke to adjacent tiles (vertical). Damage: 1. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: More Smoke (2 Reactor Cores): Adds Smoke to more tiles (in 4 directions); +2 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases the center tile damage by 2. Passive: Nanofilter Mending: Standing on Smoke repairs mechs and removes Smoke. Power: Free.

name: Control Mech
text: Keywords: Flying. Health 2, move 4. Weapon: Control Shot: Temporarily control a unit, moving it a short distance (2 tiles). Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Move (1 Reactor Core): Targeted unit can move one extra tile; +1 Move (2 Reactor Cores): Targeted unit can move one extra tile.

name: Burst Beam
text: Fire a piercing beam that decreases in damage the further it goes. Damage: 3-1. Power: Free. Upgrades: Ally Immune (1 Reactor Core): Friendly units will not take damage from this attack. (Buildings will still be damaged and shields will be removed); +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Increases the starting damage by 1.

name: Sidewinder Fist
text: Punch an adjacent tile, damaging and pushing it to the left. Damage: 2. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 1; +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases damage by 1. (Powering both upgrades allows you to move a square when you attack).

name: Fissure Fist
text: Heavily damage a tile, cracking tiles behind the target on kill. Single-use. Damage: 3. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increase damage to the target by 1; +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: The Big One
text: Fires a huge missile that damages in a large cone shape. (Deals 3 damage to target, 2 to 3 tiles behind it, and 1 to 5 tiles further behind. Has knockback.) Damage: 3-1 (2 to self). Power: Free. Upgrades: -1 Self Damage (1 Reactor Core): Deals 1 less damage to the user; -1 Self Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Deals 1 less damage to the user.

name: Rail Cannon
text: Projectile that does more damage to targets that are further away. Damage: 0 - 2. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Max Damage (1 Reactor Core): Increases max damage by 1; +2 Max Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases max damage by 2.

name: Arachnoid Injector
text: Damage target, creating a friendly robot spider on kill. Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (2 Reactor Cores): Increases the artillery attack damage by 1; Acidic (1 Reactor Core): Adds ACID to the attack of the Arachnoid.

name: Tri-Rocket
text: Damage and push 3 tiles in a line. (Can aim close tile.) Damage: 1. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores): Deals 1 additional damage to all targets; Building Immune (1 Reactor Core): This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings.

name: Smoke Pellets
text: Surround yourself with Smoke to defend against nearby enemies. Single-use. Power: Free. Upgrades: Ally Immune (1 Reactor Core): No longer applies Smoke on self or allies; +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Repair Drop
text: Heal all player units (including disabled Mechs). Single-use. Power: Free.

name: Flood Drill
text: Convert any liquid Tile to a Hole, spreading the liquid to adjacent tiles. Single-use. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Use (1 Reactor Core): Increases uses per battle by 1.

name: Viscera Nanobots
text: Mechs heal 1 damage when they deal a killing blow. Power: Free. Upgrades: +1 Heal (2 Reactor Cores): Increase healing to 2.

name: Networked Armor
text: All Mechs gain +1 HP. Power: 1 Reactor Core. Upgrades: +1 Health (2 Reactor Cores): Increases health bonus to 2.

name: Gana
text: Pilot ability: Preemptive Strike: Deploy anywhere on the map, damaging adjacent enemies. (1 power required)

name: Lily Reed
text: Pilot ability: Impulsive: Gain +3 Move on first turn of every mission.

name: Morgan Lejeune
text: Pilot ability: Field Research: Mech gains Boosted on kill.

name: Mafan
text: Pilot ability: Zoltan: +1 Reactor Core. Reduce Mech HP to 1. Gain Shield every turn.

name: Pull-Tank (unit)
text: Health 1, move 3. It can pull targets with a projectile.
